summary: Frontend-only test (Playwright at 390x844 and 360x640, plus a static data check). ALLGEMEINES REGISTER, ALL PASS: /way lists 24 topic cards and way-open-topics is gone. way-search finds the new topics (Neid, Geld, Tod, Stille, Eifersucht, Beruf, Partnerschaft, Eltern, Alter, Ohnmacht, Ewigkeit, Mangel, Sinn, Neuanfang ...). Every way-cat-* filter includes the new topics, and the 7 categories add up to 24. All 12 new /way/topic/<id> screens render topic-screen-<id> with all 14 section headings, passages, people, Jesus, prayer, care, related, lexicon and stations. There are no page errors. All 36 topic-related-* chips navigate correctly. Lexicon and station chips navigate. The passage context sheet opens, 'Im Bibelleser öffnen' leads to /bible?...&way=<id>, and way-return-button goes back to the topic. Static check: all ELB1905 refs in topics3/topics4 are inside the verse counts, and all related, feeling, lexicon and station ids exist. Bible reader: verse-way-topics lists the new topics (Mt 20,15 -> neid-vergleich; Ps 131,2 -> frieden-stille; Pred 3,11 -> arbeit-sinn + sterben-tod; Hi 19,7 -> ungerechtigkeit; 1Mo 4,7 -> neid-vergleich), and the chip navigates to the topic. Check-in: 'neidisch' suggests neid-vergleich first, 'gottfern' suggests gebet-schwer first. topic-to-diary pre-fills the topic. TOPIC IMAGE BUG (HIGH): on web the topic-image box is 358x747 (it takes the source's natural height), so the 'contain' image has about 230px of empty space above and below it. The image is not distorted, but the layout is broken. Data issues: 3 station links point to the wrong parable, and 2 topics have an empty 'Lerneinheiten' section. MAP RETEST: FIXED: the Jerusalem cluster dot (+2) at start opens the Jerusalem sheet at 390 and 360. No hidden marker keeps pointer-events active. FIXED: the revelation map shows all 8 dots and all 8 church names at start. NOT FIXED (HIGH): the wide maps still start on empty areas. Visible dots at start: tora 1 of 21 (haran, under the HUD), prophets 1 of 12 (nineveh, under a chip), acts 1 of 16 (athens), letters 4 of 9 (2 of them covered). REGRESSION (HIGH): in the overview at start, the shiloh dot opens the Jericho sheet and the jericho dot opens the Jerusalem sheet. The place-art illustrations lie on top of the neighbouring dots. The capernaum, nazareth and carmel dots sit under the verse-of-day card at 390 (5 northern dots are covered at 360), so they cannot be tapped. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

ui_bugs.issue: On web the Image takes the source height (747px) and ignores aspectRatio. The box is 358x747 at 390px width, so the 'contain' picture has about 230px of empty space above and below it. Same for all 12 new topics. Reference: app/way/topic/[id].tsx:58

ui_bugs.component: Overview map start: illustration covers dots
ui_bugs.issue: Tapping the dot centre opens the wrong sheet: shiloh opens Jericho, jericho opens Jerusalem. elementFromPoint returns place-art-jericho and place-art-jerusalem. This worked in iteration 33. The start box now includes capernaum, so the zoom is smaller and the art covers more. Reference: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:76

ui_bugs.component: Overview map start: verse card covers dots
ui_bugs.issue: At 390 the capernaum, nazareth and carmel dots are under verse-of-day, and tapping them opens no sheet. At 360 the capernaum, carmel, caesarea, shechem and joppa dots are covered. fitT uses padTop=topH, which does not seem to include the verse card. This is still open from iteration 33.

tora, prophets and acts start with only 1 place in view (letters: 4 of 9, 2 of them covered). RCA: initial = placesBox(map, null) is wider than the viewport, and fitT clamps the scale to minS (cover). The view is then centred on the middle of the box, which is empty (the Arabian desert for tora and prophets, the Aegean for acts). Reference: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:76, src/components/ZoomableMap.tsx:96-101

integration_issues.issue: Station links do not match the cited texts. arbeit-sinn cites Mt 25,14-30 (Talente) but links parables-5 'Das verlorene Schaf'; it should be parables-9. geld-sorge cites Lk 12,13-21 (Kornbauer) but links parables-3 'Der Sauerteig'; parables-4 'Schatz im Acker' or parables-9 would fit. familie cites Lk 15,11-32 but links parables-7 'Barmherziger Samariter'; it should be parables-6 'Der verlorene Sohn'. Reference: src/data/way/topics3.ts:120,154,225

liebe-partnerschaft (topics3.ts:189) and mut-neuanfang (topics4.ts:143) have stations: [], so the 'Lerneinheiten' heading has nothing under it. Add stations or hide the heading when the list is empty.

issues: The topics that fit the chosen feeling are only sorted first. They are not marked visually, and all 24 chips follow as a very long list.

action_items: HIGH: app/way/topic/[id].tsx:58: wrap the Image in <View style={{ width: '100%', aspectRatio: ratio, borderRadius, overflow: 'hidden' }}> and give the Image width '100%' and height '100%'. On web the Image currently falls back to the source height of 747px.

HIGH: wide maps (tora, prophets, acts, letters): when the places box does not fit at cover minS, centre on a meaningful focus instead of the box centre, for example a per-map focus or start place (Canaan for tora and prophets, Jerusalem/Antioch for acts) or the first route. Another option is contain fit for these maps.

HIGH: overview start: the place-art for Jericho and Jerusalem covers the shiloh and jericho dots. Give dots a higher zIndex than the art, or set pointerEvents none on the art where it overlaps dots. Also make padTop include the verse-of-day card (or collapse it at start) so the capernaum, nazareth and carmel dots are not under it.
MEDIUM: fix the station ids: arbeit-sinn parables-5 -> parables-9; geld-sorge parables-3 -> parables-4 or parables-9; familie parables-7 -> parables-6.
LOW: add stations for liebe-partnerschaft and mut-neuanfang, or hide the empty 'Lerneinheiten' label (and likewise for an empty Lexikon list).
critical_code_review_comments: ZoomableMap fitT: s is clamped to minS, so fitting any box wider than the cover viewport just centres on the box middle. This is why the iteration 33 fix had no effect for wide maps.
Topic screen: the label headings for Lexikon and Lerneinheiten render even when their lists are empty.

success_rate.frontend: ~82% (register/search/categories/12 topics/bible/check-in pass; image layout, wide-map start, overview dot overlap fail)

seed_data_creation: None. Accepted the diary privacy intro in the test browser; no diary entry saved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use https://gottes-wort-app.preview.emergentagent.com (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Close the intro with 'Überspringen' and then 'Bibel entdecken'. For map taps use mouse.click on the dot centre and check elementFromPoint, because place-art and verse-of-day can cover dots. /bible?b=Ps&ch=131&v=2 deep-links to a verse. Run python3 /app/backend/tests/check_way_topics_static.py to validate topic refs and ids.
rca_of_issue: Topic image: RN-web Image uses the intrinsic source size when height is not set, and that overrides aspectRatio. Wide maps: placesBox is wider than the viewport at cover minS, clampS keeps minS, and the view is centred on the empty middle of the box. Overview regression: the new start box (with capernaum, 0.1 minFrac) lowers the scale, so the Jericho and Jerusalem art overlaps the shiloh and jericho dots and catches the taps.
